description.en: An AI gateway by the OpenCode team with limited-time free models (MiMo-V2.5 Free, Big Pickle, Nemotron 3 Ultra Free etc.) and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
description.zh-Hans: OpenCode 团队推出的 AI 网关，提供限时免费模型（MiMo-V2.5 Free、Big Pickle、Nemotron 3 Ultra Free 等）与 OpenAI 兼容端点。
description.zh-Hant: OpenCode 团队推出的 AI 网关，提供限时免费模型（MiMo-V2.5 Free、Big Pickle、Nemotron 3 Ultra Free 等）与 OpenAI 兼容端点。

detail.en: OpenCode Zen is an AI gateway maintained by the OpenCode team, primarily used inside the opencode coding CLI (TUI) via /connect + API key, and also exposes OpenAI-compatible endpoints (https://opencode.ai/zen/v1). Currently free (limited-time) models include MiMo-V2.5 Free, Big Pickle, Nemotron 3 Ultra Free, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free, Ling 3.0 Flash Fin Free and Muse Spark 1.2 Contributor Free; the list changes often. Free models are available without billing details; paid models are metered per token with auto-recharge. Check the official docs for the current list.
detail.zh-Hans: OpenCode Zen 是 OpenCode 团队维护的 AI 网关，主要在 opencode 编码 CLI（TUI）中通过 /connect 与 API Key 使用，同时暴露 OpenAI 兼容端点（https://opencode.ai/zen/v1）。当前限时免费模型包括 MiMo-V2.5 Free、Big Pickle、Nemotron 3 Ultra Free、Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free、Ling 3.0 Flash Fin Free、Muse Spark 1.2 Contributor Free 等，名单经常变化。免费模型无需添加账单信息即可使用；付费模型按 token 计费并支持自动充值。当前名单请以官方文档为准。
